title: [Bug]: Qwen3.6 hybrid model with prefix caching + MTP3 causes tool-call leakage and needle recall failure, while no-MTP path is correct[错误]：
body:
### Your current environment
The output of python collect_env.py ```text Your output of `python collect_env.py` here ```
### 🐛 Describe the bug ### Summary When serving a Qwen3.6/Qwen3.5-style hybrid model with vLLM prefix caching and MTP3 speculative decoding enabled, the engine shows severe correctness regressions on cache-hit paths. The no-MTP hard-cache path works correctly with high prefix-cache hit rate. The MTP3 hard-cache path still gets cache hits, but tool calling, multi-turn tool use, and long-context needle recall fail. This looks related to hybrid full-attention + Mamba/GDN prefix-cache state reuse under speculative decoding, rather than a model-template-only issue. ### Environment Hardware: * 2 × RTX 2080 Ti 22GB * Turing / SM75 * Tensor parallel: 2 Model: * Qwopus3.6-27B-Coder-GPTQ-Pro * Qwen3.6 / Qwen3.5-style hybrid architecture * GPTQ-Pro / gptq_marlin path Serving: * OpenAI-compatible vLLM server * Tool parser: qwen3_coder * Reasoning parser: qwen3 * enable_thinking=false * CUDA graphs enabled * Prefix caching enabled * Prefix hash algorithm: sha256_cbor * KV cache dtype: fp8_e5m2 * MTP: 3 speculative tokens Please note: I intentionally avoided TurboQuant KV for this reproduction. The failing setup uses fp8_e5m2 KV. ### What works Hard-cache without MTP works correctly. Configuration: * fp8_e5m2 KV * prefix cache enabled * MTP/speculative decoding disabled Observed results: * vLLM engine prefix cache hit rate around 90-98% * real ClaudeCode/OpenClaw-style payload with about 58K static prefix hits correctly * cold prefill around 6s, hot prefill around 0.05s * streaming first-token latency improves strongly: * 58K long conversation: 19.31s cold to 3.40s hot * 8K tool request: 3.09s cold to 1.31s hot * 60K rich context: 11.58s cold to 4.12s hot * tool calling works * needle recall 10K/30K works * no content leak * no reasoning leak * no `` text leak * no repetition/star leakage ### What fails The same hard-cache setup fails after enabling MTP3. Configuration: * fp8_e5m2 KV * prefix cache enabled * MTP3 enabled * same model * same parser * same prompt/template path * same CUDA graphs path Observed results: * server starts successfully * prefix cache still works * 58K static prefix hit rate around 83.9% * cold PP 23.35s to hot avg 2.03s, about 91.3% reduction * no engine crash But correctness regresses badly: * tool call 10x: only 2/10 pass * multicase 18x: only 1/18 pass * needle recall 10K/30K: 0/10 pass * multi-turn tool use: 0/5 pass * `` XML leaks as plain text * repetition appears in at least one case * tool parser does not populate valid tool_calls reliably ### Why this looks like a vLLM prefix-cache + speculative decoding issue The failure only appears when MTP3 is combined with prefix caching on this hybrid model path. Important observations: * no-MTP + prefix cache works * fp8_e5m2 KV + prefix cache works * MTP3 starts and generates text * cache hit rate remains high * failures appear on structured/tool-call and recall tasks * the failing behavior resembles unsafe cache/state reuse rather than normal model quality degradation This seems related to prior hybrid prefix-cache + speculative decoding work, including: * unsafe prefix-cache hit with hybrid full-attention + Mamba/GDN models when EAGLE/MTP is enabled * Qwen3 tool parser / reasoning parser edge cases involving `` * speculative decoding interacting with structured outputs ### Expected behavior Prefix caching should be behavior-preserving. Enabling MTP3 should not change whether: * tool_calls are parsed correctly * `` appears only as structured tool call, not plain text * needle recall succeeds * multi-turn tool use works If MTP3 cannot safely reuse prefix-cached hybrid Mamba/GDN states, vLLM should either: 1. avoid unsafe hits, 2. disable the unsupported path with a clear warning, 3. or correctly roll back / verify speculative KV and Mamba/GDN state. ### Actual behavior MTP3 + prefix cache produces cache-hit speedups but breaks correctness: * tool-call text leakage * missing tool_calls * needle recall failure * multi-turn tool failure * occasional repetition ### Reproduction outline 1. Start vLLM with Qwen3.6/Qwen3.5-style hybrid model. 2. Enable prefix caching. 3. Use fp8_e5m2 KV. 4. Enable qwen3_coder tool parser and qwen3 reasoning parser. 5. Use a long static prefix, about 58K tokens, with dynamic suffix changes. 6. Warm the prefix cache. 7. Verify cache hits. 8. Run: * tool call prompt, 10 repetitions * multicase tool-call prompt, 18 repetitions * needle recall at 10K/30K * multi-turn tool use 9. Compare no-MTP vs MTP3. No-MTP passes. MTP3 fails. ### Request Could maintainers clarify whether Qwen3.6/Qwen3.5 hybrid Mamba/GDN prefix caching is expected to be compatible with MTP speculative decoding? If this is known to require recent fixes, which PRs or commits should be backported? I am especially interested in fixes around: * hybrid prefix-cache hit computation * Mamba/GDN state checkpoint reuse * speculative decoding rollback / verification with prefix cache * Qwen3 coder/XML tool parser interaction with speculative decoding * reasoning parser handling of `` lookahead ### Before submitting a new issue... - [x] Make sure you already searched for relevant issues, and asked the chatbot living at the bottom right corner of the [documentation page](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/), which can answer lots of frequently asked questions.
